custom_logic_notes: EA is a pivot-based open system that calculates daily TimeZone-adjusted pivot levels (PP, R1-R3, S1-S3) and places pending stop orders at or between these levels. Orders are placed at the start of each new trading day after pivot recalculation. The 'Open System' designation means it uses pending orders at pivot levels rather than market orders on breakouts. Pending orders are managed - deleted if not triggered within the day and re-placed on new pivot calculations. The timezone adjustment shifts the traditional pivot calculation window to match a user-specified session open time.
python_conversion_notes: Must replicate TimeZonePivots custom indicator logic in Python - extract the timezone-shifted pivot calculation (previous day HLC shifted by timezone offset). Pending order management requires a state machine: place orders at pivot levels on new day, monitor for triggers, delete untriggered orders at session end. SL/TP are placed at adjacent pivot levels rather than fixed pips, so the pip distance varies daily based on volatility. No digit adjustment needed since levels are price-based not pip-based. The timezone offset parameter must be preserved as it shifts which candle's HLC is used for pivot calculation.
